simulationType: FUTURES_REPLICATION (1 contract per signal, whole contracts only)
costScenariosNote: Scenario A = zero cost | Scenario B = 0.85 EUR per execution (INNO scenario) | Scenario C = 0.95 USD per execution (INNO scenario). 1 round trip = 2 executions.
dataIntegrityStatement: No values invented. No ETF prices used as futures proxies. GLD Thursday Long marked RESEARCH_ETF_ONLY because trade file contains GLD ETF prices (~$40–300/share), not gold oz futures prices (~$430–3200/oz). 12 seasonal strategies have no individual trade files in repo — marked NO_TRADE_DATA.

components.label: EURUSD 30M
components.notes: Monitoring-only (2026). No historical backtest file. M6E = 12,500 EUR notional per contract. Cannot simulate 2008–2026 period.

components.label: DAX 1H
components.notes: Monitoring-only (2025–2026). No historical backtest file. FDXS = 1 EUR/DAX index point. Cannot simulate 2008–2026 period.

components.label: GLD Thursday Long
components.notes: Trade file contains GLD ETF prices (e.g., entry_price=44.38 in 2004). Gold oz futures price in 2004 was ~$430/oz. ETF share price ≠ futures price. Cannot compute 1OZ futures P&L without gold oz futures price series. Existing pnl field = ETF per-share P&L, not futures P&L. Marked RESEARCH_ETF_ONLY.

components.label: Dow Jones TAT
components.pnlFieldNote: Existing pnl field in source file uses DYNAMIC sizing (ratio 5.78–7.78× vs price diff). It is NOT 1-contract P&L and is ignored in this simulation.
components.notes: All trades LONG (strategy is long-only by design, no direction field). YM1! = Dow Jones continuous front-month futures. MYM = Micro E-mini Dow, 0.5 USD/point.

components.label: DAX 2H
components.formula: LONG: grossPnl = (exitPrice - entryPrice) × 1 EUR | SHORT: grossPnl = (entryPrice - exitPrice) × 1 EUR
components.crossVerification: grossR × |entryPrice - stopPrice| × 1 EUR = direct price formula. Verified identical on sampled trades.
components.notes: Has LONG and SHORT directions. FDXS = Micro DAX, 1 EUR per DAX index point.
